2607.22529.title: Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
2607.22529.paper_summary: LLM training is shifting from manual design and annotation to interaction-driven self-evolution. However, existing self-evolutionary methods face a fundamental dilemma between task diversity and verification reliability: environment-bound methods obtain precise feedback but confine learning to narrow domains, while open-ended self-generation broadens the task space but lacks reliable verification, allowing misleading rewards to pollute the training loop. We identify agent skills as a powerful middle ground to reconcile this tension: each skill ensures deep, verifiable execution in a specific scenario, while dynamic routing across skills maintains open-ended task variety. Leveraging this insight, we introduce Skill Self-Play (Skill-SP), a co-evolutionary framework comprising a proposer, a solver, and a dynamic skill controller. Orchestrated via a reinforcement learning loop, these components co-evolve in a continuous self-play loop: the proposer generates challenging tasks conditioned on dynamically sampled skills; the solver explores candidate solutions to push its capability boundaries; and the skill controller collects execution feedback to update and expand the skill library. This interactive co-evolution effectively bridges the gap between structured verification and open-ended exploration. Empirical evaluations on tool-use and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Skill-SP, serving as a robust evolution engine, consistently pushes the performance ceiling of competent backbones while catalyzing striking turnarounds for initially misaligned models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/skill-self-play.
2607.22529.paper_summary_zh: LLM 訓練正從手動設計和標註轉向以互動驅動的自我進化。然而，現有的自我進化方法面臨著任務多樣性和驗證可靠性之間的根本困境：環境綁定的方法獲得精確的反饋，但將學習限制在狹窄的領域，而開放式自我生成則擴大了任務空間，但缺乏可靠的驗證，導致誤導性的獎勵污染訓練循環。我們將代理技能視為調和這一緊張關係的有力中介：每項技能確保在特定場景中進行深入、可驗證的執行，而跨技能的動態路由則保持開放式任務的多樣性。利用這一見解，我們引入了技能自我遊戲（Skill Self-Play，Skill-SP），這是一個由提議者、解決者和動態技能控制器組成的共同進化框架。這些組件通過強化學習循環進行協調，共同在持續的自我遊戲循環中進化：提議者根據動態抽樣的技能生成具有挑戰性的任務；解決者探索候選解決方案以推動其能力邊界；而技能控制器收集執行反饋以更新和擴展技能庫。這種互動式共同進化有效地彌合了結構化驗證和開放式探索之間的差距。在工具使用和推理基準上的實證評估顯示，作為強大進化引擎的 Skill-SP 一直在推動能幹骨幹的性能上限，同時促進最初不對齊模型的顯著轉變。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/skill-self-play 獲得。
